title: Newer Super Mario Bros. DS - Cloudbolt Chasm
description:
This is a port of the music from Newer Super Mario Bros. DS in the level Cloudbolt Chasm. It is a Minor remix of the yoshi's island athletic theme.
Works for thunderstorm levels or for levels with a dark theme.

Works with the lightning SFX.
